visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female dentist wearing blue scrubs, a surgical mask, and a colorful patterned surgical cap holds an inflated white latex glove that resembles a bunny. She demonstrates it to a young toddler girl with short dark hair sitting in a beige dental chair. The toddler wears a pink t-shirt with a Daruma doll print and checkered leggings. The background is a bright dental clinic with medical equipment, a blue basin, and white cabinetry. (2) A slightly older girl with pigtails and a beige t-shirt enters the frame, holding a metal dental mirror. She pretends to examine the toddler's mouth. The toddler looks curious and touches the chair. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional medical environment. The camera focuses on the interaction between the two children. (3) The toddler lies back in the dental chair, visibly distressed and crying with an open mouth. The dentist in blue scrubs and another adult assistant use tools and gauze to work on the child's teeth. A woman in a beige sweater, the mother, sits next to the chair, holding the child's hand for comfort. The scene shows the intense physical activity of a dental procedure. (4) The toddler is now sitting on her mother's lap in the dental chair. The mother, wearing a beige knit sweater, holds the child close. The chair is seen moving vertically. The toddler looks calmer but still somewhat apprehensive, holding a bunny-shaped balloon. The dental equipment and monitors displaying clinical records are visible in the background. (5) The mother holds the toddler upright, and they both look toward the camera. The toddler is clapping her hands. They are in the same dental clinic setting. Finally, a pink screen appears with a cartoon illustration of a girl and the text POPO'S DAILY LIFE, marking the end of the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The sequence begins with a warm, friendly adult female voice speaking in Mandarin. The background music is a mid-tempo, playful acoustic-style track featuring a bright synthesizer melody. The ambient floor is very clean, resembling a quiet indoor professional studio or clinic. (2) A younger child's voice enters, exhibiting a high pitch and curious inflection. The BGM maintains its steady, bouncy rhythm. There is a distinct, short metallic clink sound as dental mirrors or tools are handled, marking a slight shift in the acoustic environment. (3) A sudden transition to high-intensity vocalizations occurs as the toddler begins to cry loudly and scream. The adult's voice becomes more authoritative yet soothing. The BGM continues, providing a contrasting cheerful layer beneath the chaotic, high-arousal distress sounds of the child. (4) A low mechanical whirring sound of the dental chair's motor is audible as it adjusts position. The toddler's crying tapers off into rhythmic whimpers. The mother's voice is heard speaking softly, with frequent pauses and a gentle pitch contour to comfort the child. (5) The audio environment shifts as rhythmic hand-clapping sounds emerge, accompanied by happy babbles from the child and praising exclamations from the adult. The BGM concludes with a final melodic resolution, followed by a brief digital pop or jingle for the outro.
